release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.8.4 (Build 77): Production Engine Hardening & Autonomous OTA Release.
• Production Runtime Hardening: Eliminated Turbopack compilation syntax issues and refactored React 19 hydration state using useSyncExternalStore to eliminate cascading re-render warnings.
• High-Priority Heads-Up Push Notifications: Full native Android 14/15 system tray push integration with custom alert tones, vibration sequences, and action triggers.
• Interactive Notification Testing Console: Live in-app composer to dispatch academic, reminder, and emergency alerts directly.
• 100% NCERT 2024–2026 Question Database: Complete curriculum coverage with zero dropped syllabus topics across Classes 5 to 12.
